name: 11 oz Vanilla Latte
caffeineNote: Wegmans publishes no caffeine figure for the 11 oz can; its 9 oz four-pack can lists 100 mg
summary: Wegmans’ own-brand canned latte, from its product listing and not yet checked against a can: cold brew with whole milk made lactose-free, cane sugar and vanilla extract, poured with nitrous oxide for a draft-style foam. The 11 oz can lists 160 calories, 15 g of sugar (5 g added) and 7 g of protein. Wegmans sells it as a single at $2.79 and publishes no caffeine figure for this size.
